newsitem.title: UNITED NATIONS: U.N. appoints new coordinator for Iraqi food plan.
newsitem.headline: U.N. appoints new coordinator for Iraqi food plan.

text.p: The United Nations on Monday appointed Denis Halliday of Ireland as the new humanitarian coordinator for the Iraqi oil-for-food plan.
Halliday, currently an assistant secretary-general in charge of personnel, will replace Staffan de Mistura, a veteran U.N. official for relief assistance official, who went to Iraq in February.
U.N. sources said de Mistura wanted to return to Rome.
Halliday previously was a regional representative for the U.N. Development Program and was U.N. resident coordinator in Thailand.
